INTEGRATIONS

Your tools.
A shared engineering context.

Choose the connection you need. Read local logs, offer reviewed context or install an optional SDK integration.

01 / Local agent logs

Claude Code · Codex · Cursor · Pi · OMP

Read supported formats, inspect provenance and import supported history. Coverage differs by provider; Cursor private formats are not assumed compatible.

02 / Context interfaces

CLI · stdio MCP · Codex Hook · Checkpoint

Use project-scoped recall and explicit candidate contributions. Review hook installation before applying it; a delivery receipt does not prove the model followed the context.

03 / Optional SDKs

TypeScript · Python · AI SDK · Responses · LangChain · OpenClaw

Install SDK and host adapters separately. Scope, cancellation and candidate capture have separate contracts. Consult the package documentation for supported versions.

04 / Governed automation

Local commands · HTTP · Connector profiles

Configure supported actions explicitly and review their exact arguments before side effects. External integrations need your own provider credentials.

Local by default. Connected by choice.

The macOS app does not bundle Electron or a Node runtime. Optional remote storage remains experimental and is documented separately.
